scope: Three selected Natural Earth-derived source polygons and decoded baseline polygons, plus original factual extraction and validation.
source_attribution: Natural Earth 5.0.0 1:10m lake data, as attributed by the pinned Pando manifest and original feature properties. Made with Natural Earth.
short_excerpt: All versions of Natural Earth raster + vector map data found on this website are in the public domain.
interpretation: The retained official terms place all versions of Natural Earth vector/raster data in the public domain and permit modification and electronic dissemination. Only the three selected lake features are retained here.
exclusions: No rights assertion is made for unrelated documents or maps. Full upstream assets and decoder dependencies are not republished.
